AN ORDINANCE TO REPEAL SECTION 114-75 OF ARTICLE III (LOCAL VEHICLE LICENSE) OF
CHAPTER 114 (TRAFFIC AND VEHICLES) THE CODE OF ORDINANCES, CITY OF MANASSAS,
VIRGINIA (2002), AS AMENDED, RELATED TO THE LOCAL VEHICLE LICENSE FEE

BE IT ORDAINED by the Council of the City of Manassas, Virginia, meeting in regular
session this 8th day of June, 2026 that Section 114-75 of Article III (Local Vehicle License) of
Chapter 114 of the Code of Ordinances, City of Manassas, Virginia, is hereby repealed.

This Ordinance is enacted upon passage at its second reading, and shall become effective
on July 1, 2026. No further vehicle license billing shall occur; no full or partial refunds for licenses
already issued shall be given.

BY ORDER OF THE COUNCIL
